FROM fact_web_order o

GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

calls.statement:
WITH o AS (
  SELECT * FROM fact_web_order
  WHERE status <> 'cancelled'
    AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
),
t AS (
  SELECT o.web_order_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN p.category = 'ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_test,
         MAX(CASE WHEN s.store_id = 999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_999,
         COUNT(f.sales_line_id) AS lines_n
  FROM o
  LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.receipt_id = o.web_order_id
  LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  GROUP BY o.web_order_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(has_test) AS test_orders, SUM(in_999) AS s999, SUM(CASE WHEN lines_n=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_lines,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS dup_ids_all
FROM t

calls.statement:
SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS d,
       COUNT(*) AS all_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN status<>'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS not_cancelled,
       SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) <> CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS utc_date_differs
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-12-07'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
